## [2026-07-31] live-fix | Live runner spammed ~180 identical tracebacks over ~1h (23:00→00:01 UTC, last trading day of July). Cause: GoldTomStrategy (brick2 turn-of-month) fires XAUUSD long at the daily rollover, but gold was in its daily maintenance break → order_send retcode 10018 "Market closed". broker.place_market raised a bare RuntimeError; one_pass caught it with LOG.exception (full traceback) every ~20s pass, and since strat._acted_day is set only AFTER a successful place_market, it retried until the market reopened. It DID self-resolve: entered at 00:01:14 UTC (XAUUSD LONG 0.01 @4105.01 ticket 81681843) ~1h "late" at the reopen price. Nothing crashed; supervisor+runner stayed alive. FIX (commit 3a1fb91, pushed origin/main): new `MarketClosed(RuntimeError)` in broker.py raised on retcode 10018 (both entry + exit paths); one_pass catches it separately → logs ONE info line going in, retries silently, logs ONE info line ("market reopened, order placed, waited …") on fill. Retry-until-open behaviour unchanged, only the log spam removed. User chose "retry silencieux" over cap-late-entry/skip. Deploys to the live box on next restart (git reset --hard origin/main).
